That said, the tour is a fantastic experience to discover another part of NYC!

reviews.comments: Totally unique experience! It opened up our eyes to the whole graffiti culture & technique and gave us an appreciation for what we see around us. But the best part of the experience was actually getting to do it yourself and realizing how addictive it can be!

Here you go:

Brought my team here as a corporate event and it was a standout choice. If your group has exhausted the usual team-building options, this is a genuinely refreshing alternative.

Then came the hands-on class, which was the highlight. Real instruction on technique before anyone touched a can, which meant people who “can’t draw anything” walked away with pieces they were actually proud of. Lots of energy, a little competitive, a lot of laughter.

This experience was top tier! Learning how to graffiti alongside a pro was so fun and a great learning experience. We also learned bout the history of graffiti as we walked through the studio and got a sneak peek at some completed and in progress pieces. We would definitely do this again!
Apse was awesome and super friendly. He explained the culture around his art and helped us jump in with basics. It was really interesting and I’ll be looking to schedule another session!!
Wonderful experience and quite enjoyable.
This was the experience I never knew I needed. I loved learning about the history, terminology and etiquette of graffiti art. I will be gifting this experience to friends in the future.

reviews.comments: excellent tour.

Will was an awesome tour guide. He was very knowledgeable, passionate, and entertaining.  My teenagers even enjoyed it and asked questions. This unique tour is one of the best I have ever been on! Highly recommend!
Amazing story telling, with respect to the victims. Recommend this tour.

I went on this tour solo and had a fantastic time, mostly because of Tyler. He clearly does his homework. He walked us through Austin’s whole story, from how the city started, through its boom years, to what it’s become now. And when he got to the murders themselves, he was careful with it. He didn’t play them up for shock value. He treated them seriously, like they actually mattered, and stayed genuinely curious about the history instead of just going for the creepy stuff.

The thing that won me over: it started raining, which apparently almost never happens in Austin, and Tyler just rolled with it. He moved us under awnings, then under trees, doing whatever he could to keep us dry, and he never lost the thread. Kept talking, kept answering questions, kept pointing out landmarks the whole time.

I had a great night, and he gave me some documentary recommendations on the case that I’m already planning to watch. If you’re thinking about it, go. Ask for Tyler.

Tyler was an excellent guide and storyteller — very knowledgeable! I had a great time on this walking tour, learnt a lot of good history and fun facts along the way too. Highly recommend to anyone interested in getting their true crime fix or even just seeing the city in a new light.

reviews.comments: A wonderful experience, even for locals from around the area! We learned so much about LA’s  food and city history and culture and discovered some amazing food gems for the future. Patricia was so sweet and engaging. A great way to spend the afternoon!

We had a great time with Patricia on the tour! She was very knowledgeable about all things tacos. We ate a bunch, made new friends, laughed and learned about history of tacos. reviews.comments: Sushmita was a fantastic and knowledgeable mixologist and instructor. My group learned so much from her class and crafted delicious drinks. She and her team were incredibly hospitable! Everything was great! Would definitely recommend!

A must-do experience in Austin!
This class was such a blast! It was the perfect mix of fun, learning, and hands-on cocktail crafting. The instructor is not only a top-notch mixologist, but also incredibly knowledgeable, engaging, and down-to-earth. We learned how to make authentic Texas-inspired cocktails using local ingredients and pro-level techniques—plus, we got to taste everything we made! The experience was interactive and social, making it perfect whether you’re a cocktail enthusiast or just looking for a great time. Highly recommend to anyone visiting or living in Austin!

She walked us through the art of making a Spicy Margarita and Lavender Haze, and it was such a fun, hands-on experience. What made it even more special was how she shared the history behind the drinks along with quick tips and tricks that made everything feel so approachable and exciting.

Sushmita’s passion and storytelling truly elevated the whole session — it wasn’t just about mixing drinks, it was about connecting with the craft. Highly recommend it if you're looking to learn, sip, and have a genuinely pleasant time. Cheers!

I had the best time at Sushmita’s mixology class! 🍸✨ Who knew I could actually shake up a real cocktail like a pro? She made everything so easy to follow and the drinks were delicious. Highly recommend for a fun evening with friends!

reviews.comments: LOVED the baby goats!

Slowing down with the goats, peacocks, geese, Rancho the donkey, and pigs on a farm in the Malibu hills in Latigo Canyon was the perfect end to my birthday. Natalia and her husband were so warm and welcoming. Hanging out with the animals and even feeding them was my favorite bit. At first I thought it wouldn't happen since my slot was not available, but then she opened a special one just so I could make it, and I couldn't be happier. This gesture says a lot about how she hosts.
Natalia is the sweetest person. She will go above and beyond for you to have a great experience. All her animals are very friendly and the cutest. Thank you Natalia 💗

Natalie was an amazing host! I brought my daughter and her two friends and they had a blast. She helped educate the girls about the animals and guided them to hold goose, chicks, and even the turkey! The animals are all super loved and well cared for. The space was big and animals were free to roam the magical land. We left with fresh eggs, homemade banana bread, carrot cake which were all sooooo good. Super thankful for creating such a wonderful experience for all of us.

A magical and peaceful place with the sweetest animals! Natalia was very kind and welcoming, making it easy for us to connect with the animals and enjoy the experience. The farm has so many thoughtful touches and relaxing places to explore or hang out. We had a really great time for my husband’s birthday. Would highly recommend it—especially to animal lovers ❤️

We had an absolutely magical experience with the animals and already can’t wait to return! Natalia is warm, welcoming, and extremely knowledgeable. A must for any animal lover. There isn’t much of a hike, and the waterfall was dry when we visited, but it was still totally worth it to spend the afternoon in a beautiful place surrounded by animals. Also, there’s a store with fresh eggs, and the most delicious carrot cake I’ve ever tasted (among other treats)! You will not regret booking this experience!

It was so fun to meet the sweet cows up close and feed them alfalfa and other greens. They were friendly and engaging and the owners showed everyone how to feed them and engage with them. They also took lots of photos with our cameras and then a group photo with the cows behind us. The kids loved the experience and the three year old at first was reluctant but after a few minutes she wanted to feed the cows with help and loved the experience. I highly recommend this experience! We plan to come again when we return to California.

reviews.comments:
We had THE BEST time tubing with Dave today! There were five of us to start, and somehow ended up with 12 women tubing, laughing, drinking, playing music and having the absolute best time 😂

Dave was amazing from start to finish. He was so personable and made everything easy and fun. He picked us up at our hotel, took us to the store for anything we needed, and pulled over anytime we needed a stop. Basically our transportation, guide, babysitter and hype man all in one 😂

He even did a great job keeping our slightly enthusiastic group of women in check when necessary, which deserves its own tip 😂

It was SO affordable for everything included, and honestly, our tip still didn’t feel like enough for everything he did. He went above and beyond and made the whole day fantastic.

If you’re thinking about tubing in Austin, BOOK WITH DAVE! You will not regret it. We had an absolute blast and will 100% do this again! 🍻🛟☀️
The BEST experience ever. Such an amazing day! Dave is absolutely wonderful and so welcoming - he did an incredible job of keeping everyone happy and the vibes 10/10. Couldn’t recommend this more

Amazing day on the water today with my wife, Dave, and a group of strangers that quickly became friends. Best little trip I have done in ages, highly recommend!

In fact, I’d go as far as to say, you can’t come to Austin and NOT experience this getaway if you are even  a little interested in water, getting away to nature plus beating the heat!

Just book it and go! You won’t regret it! Dave is one of a kind good people!
Good trip
Dave was amazing! He was super easygoing and so kind! My girl friends and I would book again with him no doubt!

10/10 excursion in Austin with the absolute best host, Dave! Right from the start, Dave was super friendly, personable, and made everyone in our group feel completely comfortable and well taken care of.

Transportation is fully handled, and there’s even a convenient gas station stop along the way to grab extra drinks and snacks. Dave makes sure the group has plenty of time to stop, swim, and make the absolute most of the day. Due to the popularity of the tour, just an FYI be aware it may just take a second for Dave to setup the tubes to float down the river. Boozy river tubing is a total must-do when visiting Austin—especially with Dave leading the way!

Had a great time with Dave on the tour! The river float is a super cool experience and very refreshing from the heat. Very nice to have transport that made it easy and didn’t have to worry about logistics. Dave made sure the group felt comfortable. Would definitely go again!

875907.byline: Uncover local secrets and quirky challenges in this wild, interactive city scavenger hunt
875907.name: Keep Austin Weird Scavenger Hunt

reviews.comments: This is a self-guided scavenger hunt/tour where you receive a pdf file with "missions" to complete around the city, and you can communicate with the host via a Whats app chat. Most of the hunt takes place on South Congress where there are some fun activities to go to various shops and outdoor murals to take photos, talk to store workers, strangers, etc... There also is an extended option that involves driving which has a few additional spots/activities that are a ~20-30 min drive from the main stretch of missions. Overall, felt a little bit pricey for the experience, and there was some miscommunication regarding the starting location (which we didn't ultimately fully confirm until ~30 min before the start time), and for one activity we were promised reimbursement for purchase of an item but never got reimbursed.

I took my three grandchildren, one who was visiting from NYC, on the Austin Scavenger Hunt. My wonderful son-in-law navigated for us! My SIL rated the activity a hit, and the grandchildren, ages 14, 13, and 9, seemed to be intently involved in doing the prescribed activities. It seems that the problem with the starting location for the driving activities has still not been corrected as reviewers in October noted. There is no connection of the address given to start with the first activity, but there is no way to know that until the first activity is received after getting to the start which is not near the actual start. Fortunately, navigator SIL knew how to adjust, but having to drive excessive unnecessary miles took time and gas.

This is a good idea in principle but it is not implemented well. First of all, the location after we booked it, it wasnt the one the host wanted us to meet. We spent the first 30 mins finding the host. Then, the host had actually sent somebody else to meet us that greeted us, split us in 2 groups and then just sent us a pdf and we never saw her again just communicated through texts. I would say half of the places had something interested the others didn't, some instructions were even not up to date.  I would not recommend.

I would not recommend this experience.

The host had incorrect instructions on where to meet for the experience on Airbnb. She claims to have sent me instructions off-platform via text message, but I did not share my number until after the event started. As a result, we did not start the experience itself until 45 minutes late.

There was limited host involvement in the experience. The host on the day (not the same as the one listed on Airbnb) met us at a coffeeshop. She electronically shared a PDF (a process that took 15 minutes due to a number of different technical issues) that had instructions for the scavenger hunt and then sent us off, telling us to communicate via text message and promising to keep 'score'. This was the ast we saw of the host. We dutifully carried out the 'hunt' (which did have fun stops) and received text responses (no score-keeping took place). 

After an hour of 'experiencing' hosting via SMS we gave up, and sat down together for in person connection.
Amazing experience!
This was such a fun and ecletic place, and it was spotlessly clean and comfortable. A lot of fun and we'd stay again!
We had an Amazing time! Thank you so much!
